how_adapted: Re-implemented in src/core/drawio.js as a standalone importer. Only the regex-based parsing approach and helper logic were adapted. The mxGraph headless model (mx-model.js), the write-back pass and all other modules were not used. Mapping to this project's element/connector model (shape types, style mapping, layers, relative geometry, html label stripping) is new code.

how_adapted: Searches run under the reuse-first protocol: GitHub repository search, GitHub code search, npm search and Stack Overflow question search (no relevant Stack Overflow answers were found, none were copied). Candidates for the CRDT, orthogonal routing and WebSocket server were absent or unsuitable: the npm 'ws' package was considered but rejected because the spec requires node:http with no runtime npm dependencies. These parts were therefore written new.
